risks: Margin-sensitive: recommend.py 2026-10-22 shows BELOW_TARGET at Rs 799 (28.95% best), 33.1% at Rs 849 (fragile), 36.9% at Rs 899; Rs 899 = Rs 450/pair, inside the Rs 390-750 single-pair dhokra range on Amazon
Jewellery: earrings are often non-returnable for hygiene but 'not as pictured' disputes are common; need clear photos with supplier permission
Brass can tarnish or cause skin reaction; do not claim nickel-free/hypoallergenic without evidence
Do not claim 'pure brass' without supplier written confirmation (policy require_evidence_for_claims)
Cheap plain brass jhumkas sell at Rs 223-499; listing must show handmade dhokra lost-wax work to justify price
Marketplace jewellery category commission may differ from the generic fee model in candidates.py
GST assumed 3% (HSN 7117 imitation jewellery), CA to confirm

review.notes: Rs 899 for 2 pairs (Rs 450/pair) sits inside the single-pair dhokra range (Arteastic Rs 390-425, iTokri Rs 590-826, Miharu ~Rs 750) and Amazon.in charges 0% referral under Rs 1,000 including jewellery, but the Rs 187/pair cost comes only from an IndiaMART snippet and a USD-converted GlobalLinker price, and the margin breaks at ~Rs 210/pair (Rs 420 for 2 -> 31.4% Amazon, 27.5% Shopify; at Rs 799 price it fails everywhere). For skin-contact jewellery we also need the supplier's written metal/alloy statement (lead and nickel content, hook material) before listing; no 'pure brass', 'nickel-free' or 'hypoallergenic' claims, and no dhokra-specific complaint pattern was found publicly but tarnish/skin-reaction risk remains; confirm Amazon/Flipkart returnability for earrings and the exact 2 designs with photo permission.
